fusions.name: Spadeful Thump
fusions.desc: Thumps the ground in a ring, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flung Dirt
fusions.desc: Flings a clod that deals 5 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Over
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
